entities.summary: Alberto Tanasini was an Italian Roman Catholic prelate. He was the auxiliary bishop of Genoa from 1996 to 2004 and bishop of Chiavari from 2004 to 2021. Tanasini died on 24 January 2024, at the age of 78.
